metadata.Syllabus Name: Database Systems_Các hệ cơ sở dữ liệu
metadata.Time Allocation: Study hour (150h) = 45h contact hours + 1h final exam + 85' practical exam + 104h self-study
metadata.Description: - Knowledge about database systems has become an essential part of an education in computer science because database management has evolved from a specialized computer application to a central component of a modern computing environment. - The content of this course includes aspects of database management basic concepts, database design, database languages, and database-system implementation. Basing on these contents, the course emphasizes on how to organize, maintain and retrieve efficiently data and information from a DBMS.
metadata.StudentTasks: - Students must attend at least 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination. - Student is responsible to do all exercises given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time - Promptly access to the https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/ for up-to-date course information

sections.heading: Syllabus Details
rows: Database Systems_Các hệ cơ sở dữ liệu
Study hour (150h) = 45h contact hours + 1h final exam + 85' practical exam + 104h self-study

- Knowledge about database systems has become an essential part of an education in computer science because database management has evolved from a specialized computer application to a central component of a modern computing environment. - The content of this course includes aspects of database management basic concepts, database design, database languages, and database-system implementation. Basing on these contents, the course emphasizes on how to organize, maintain and retrieve efficiently data and information from a DBMS.

- Students must attend at least 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination. - Student is responsible to do all exercises given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time - Promptly access to the https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/ for up-to-date course information

sections.heading: 7 LO(s)
rows: Understand thedatabase concepts and database management system software
Understand the relation model of data and Algebraic Query Language
Understand data normalization and apply normalization techniques in database design
Be able to model an application’s data requirements using conceptual modeling tools like ER diagrams and design database schemas based on the conceptual model.
Be proficient in structure query language including Data Definition Language(DDL) and Data Manipulation Language(DML)
Understand PL/SQL concepts and manipulate with View, Cursors, Stored Procedures, Functions, Database Triggers
Apply the Index in database design and query optimization

sections.heading: 30 Constructive question(s)
rows: Why do we need database? How many stages of upgrade or development has the database gone through? Why did that happen? What is Database System?
What is a Database System and the role of Database Systems? What is a Database Management System? What and how can programmers do with the database?
What is Data Model? What belong to a Data Model?How can we describe and give some examples of the Relations, Attributes, Tuples, Domains?
What are Relation instances, Schema, DB schema. How can we use SQL to define relation schemas?
What is an Algebra? What is Relational Algebra? Why do we need Algebraic Query Language?
What are usecases of Relational Algebra Operations?
How can we express constrains by relational algebra?
How can we use relational algebra to define constrains in some database?
What are Functional Dependencies? Why you need rules about Functional Dependencies? What is usecase of each rule?
What are keys, super-keys, closure-sets, closing sets of FD’s and how to determine them?
What are Anomalies? Can we solve Anomalies? How to solve?
Why should we decompose a relation?
What is a simple way to normalize schema to 1NF, 2NF, 3NF, BCNF? Please, give some examples.
What are the good, bad and ugly of decomposition?
What is Database model? How can we describe the Database Design Process?
How many Level Database Model? What are they?
Why do we use Conceptual Design (or Logical Design)?
What are Entity, Entity Set, Entity Instances, Attributes and others in ERD?
What is a relationship and how to realize it? How can we draw an ERD?
Are there any principles or constraints in designing ERDs?
How can we use simple queries in some examples?
How can we query data involving more than one relation? Please, give some examples.
What are subqueries? Can you apply them im some examples?
How can we use grouping and aggregate functions? Please, give some examples.
What is HAVING clause? When should we use grouping and aggregate functions with HAVING clauses? Why?
What are DDL, DML? How can we describe INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE queries? Please, give some examples.
How can we use SQL to create/modify constraints of a relation?
What is a trigger? Why do we use triggers?
How many components in a trigger? How to create a trigger?
